notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
- Enemies balanced.

- Slingshot was improved!

- Shield attack speed was increased!

- Show collected Shooting Stars in stages!

notes.title: Small Bugs Fixed
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where the player would die on an enemy's head!

- Fixed a bug where the player would move and jump at the same time, resulting in the jump being canceled!

- Fixed the path to a secret stage!
